svg.title: Activate a run and execute its pipeline

g.text: Activate a run and execute its pipeline
bind realms and ad hoc slots
to free lab stages and components
[each step whose needs are met (in parallel)]
put inputs, setsid + pid file, wait_for
release what the next phase does not use
the exploit phase is a phase like the others: its steps
run on the sequencer component, on the outputs collected before
